gloss: busy farming season; peak agricultural period

definitions.gloss: busy farming season; peak agricultural period
definitions.explanation: The time of year when farming work is most intensive, particularly during planting (spring) and harvesting (autumn). The opposite of {農閑期|のうかんき} (slack farming season).

examples.japanese: {農繁期|のうはんき}は{人手|ひとで}が{足|た}りない。
examples.english: There aren't enough workers during the busy farming season.

examples.japanese: {農繁期|のうはんき}には{朝|あさ}から{晩|ばん}まで{田|た}んぼで{働|はたら}く。
examples.english: During the busy farming season, we work in the rice paddies from morning to night.

examples.japanese: かつては{農繁期|のうはんき}になると{学校|がっこう}を{休|やす}む{子|こ}どもも{多|おお}かった。
examples.english: In the past, many children would miss school during the busy farming season.

notes:
Compound of {農|のう} (agriculture) + {繁|はん} (busy/flourishing) + {期|き} (period). In Japan, the main {農繁期|のうはんき} periods are spring ({田植|たう}え, rice planting) and autumn ({稲刈|いねか}り, rice harvesting). Historically, school schedules and local events were arranged around these periods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {農繁期|のうはんき}に{入|はい}る: to enter the busy farming season
- {農繁期|のうはんき}の{手伝|てつだ}い: helping during busy farming season
- {農繁期|のうはんき}{休暇|きゅうか}: farming season leave (historically given to school children)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {農閑期|のうかんき}: slack farming season — the opposite, the quiet period between planting and harvesting
- {繁忙期|はんぼうき}: busy season — a general term for any industry's peak period, not limited to farming
- {収穫期|しゅうかくき}: harvest season — specifically the autumn harvest period
